audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating is 7.5/10 ("TRICKY") while the Emerald+ data shows Darius winning 52.68% over 4941 games. A lane he wins is not a 7.5.
audit.why: Karma is genuinely annoying (950-range Q, Inspire move speed, a root Darius cannot outrun) but the outcome data says Darius comes out ahead. 6.5/10 matches both the feel and the number.
audit.corrected: diffRating 6.5/10; breakdown.difficulty and report[14] restated to cite the 52.7% figure and name the real deciding factor (punishing Focused Resolve's flat 12s downtime).

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Karma wins Level 6 (win[4]=Karma, phases[4].side=Karma, 3/10) while the why text on the same row argues the opposite ("Noxian Guillotine turns any 5-stack trade into a kill"). whys[4] also claims Karma's ult grants no burst as if her R were a level-6 unlock.
audit.why: Riot's own text on Mantra: "Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point." Karma's level 6 is only a Mantra rank-up, no new tool. Darius's level 6 is Noxian Guillotine — true damage, 120s at rank 1, refreshes on a kill. Level 6 is Darius's spike, not hers.
audit.corrected: Level-6 row flipped to Darius 6/10 as an atomic chart change (win[4] and phases[4].side/.rating together). Final chart: Karma, Skill, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius. The spike text now states the real level-6 caveat: Mantra-Inspire's shield absorbs the execute, so the shield has to be stripped before R.
sources: champ-data/_kits darius R text (cd 120/100/80, trueDamage flag)

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and phases[0].why both claim Darius wins level 1 ("Karma has no early trade tool", "Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges") while win[0] and phases[0].side both say Karma.
audit.why: Karma has Mantra at level 1 with no skill point spent, so an empowered Inner Flame is available in the first wave at 950 range against a 175-range melee. The side (Karma) was right; the two why strings were wrong.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten to state the Mantra-at-1 fact and give Darius the actual level-1 plan (soak, hold ground, last-hit). Side left on Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] invents an ability profile: "empowered slow-tether". Karma's slow is on Inner Flame (Q); the tether is Focused Resolve (W), and its Mantra bonus heals her and extends the root — it does not slow. The decisive Apprehend property (minions do not block it) is never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q "sends forth a ball of spirit energy" with the slow flag; W "creates a tether... rooted", Mantra bonus "healing herself and extending the root duration". Apprehend is a 535-range cone sweep, not a single-target skillshot, so a wave between you and Karma does not stop the pull — that is the whole reason Darius beats her once she steps to CS.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] restated with the real slot mapping (Inner Flame slows, Mantra makes it a delayed cataclysm) and the Apprehend-through-minions fact; report[5] and the cooldown breakdown restated the same way.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says what to do when Focused Resolve tethers you. The existing line ("breaks if you LoS / outrange it") tells Darius to run away, which is the losing play.
audit.why: Riot's text: "If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted." It breaks on line of sight or on leaving range — but Darius sprinting backwards out of 675 range while she has Inspire move speed usually fails, and even when it works he has given up the trade. Terrain breaks it instantly; committing through it puts him on top of her when the root lands, which costs him nothing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, winCon, report[1] and breakdown.cooldowns now say: flat 12s at 675 range, break it on terrain or commit through it, never walk away.
sources: champ-data/_kits karma W text, cd 12 flat, range 675

audit.whatIsWrong: Noxian Guillotine is described as an unanswerable execute. Karma's Inspire shield absorbs it.
audit.why: Guillotine's trueDamage flag means resistances do not reduce it — but a shield is not a resistance, it is a hit-point pool, so Inspire (and the far larger Mantra-Inspire) eats the execute and can put her back above the threshold. This is the single most common way a Darius R goes wasted in this lane.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[4].why, whys[4] and spikes[1]: strip the shield, stack to 5, then press R.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists "Your engage/committal tool" and "Your ultimate" as unnamed placeholders with no numbers.
audit.why: The real numbers make the advice actionable: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 falling to 16s at rank 5, so a whiff genuinely concedes the wave; Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank, which is why baiting it is a repeatable pattern rather than a one-off.
audit.corrected: Cooldown breakdown now names Apprehend (16-26s by rank) and Noxian Guillotine, and gives Focused Resolve its flat 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentions Grievous Wounds despite Karma's Mantra-W self-heal.
audit.why: Flagged in _missing for this exact pairing: Mantra bonus on Focused Resolve heals her, so extended trades — which is what Darius wants — are the trades her sustain is designed to beat.
audit.corrected: report[8] now calls for Executioner's Calling early, alongside the existing Stridebreaker / Sterak's / Mercury's Treads line.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] pairs the title "Land the Q outer ring to heal" with a description about Karma wasting Focused Resolve — the two do not match, and the heal rule is never explained.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade." Handle hits and minion hits give nothing, which is exactly the mistake players make when they Q into the wave to poke.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d replaced with the actual rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma is referred to as "he"/"him"/"his" throughout the full layer (tldr, winCon, ahead, dosFull, dontsFull, report[0]).
audit.why: Karma is female. Wrong pronouns on a live coaching page read as machine-generated and undercut trust in the facts next to them.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every string this proposal touches. Remaining untouched instances are listed in notes for a pronoun sweep.
